verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud's docs mention a JavaScript runtime for building agents and custom business logic, which hints at a programmable automation surface. Nothing shows that these run autonomously in the background on triggers or schedules. Data sources can follow different update schedules, but that describes data organization, not automation. missing for 10: documented scheduled or triggered background jobs, autonomous agent execution without user prompts, setup docs for automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
